BiblicalUsage: Once, in the flight of Absalom: Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day; the name is the father of the king who shelters the murderer, and the shelter is all the Bible says of him.
TheologicalSignificance: The father's name is the whole of it, and the refuge is the point: Absalom fled to his grandfather's house in Geshur and stayed there three years.
